summary: Feed s164_triple to NDR is degraded with 3 high-severity faults: 95.2% ERSPAN encapsulation not stripped, microbursts to 21.72 Gbps overloading 10 Gbps tool port (217%), and 17.8% one-way TCP sessions. Tool cannot parse inner payload, drops bursts, and fails stateful reassembly.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker/SPAN is forwarding only one direction for many flows. 95 of 535 TCP sessions (17.8%) are unidirectional, exceeding 10% threshold. Typical cause is single-sided SPAN/TAP or failure to aggregate both directions of asymmetric routing at the broker before delivery to the NDR.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs_both_directions=true for stateful TCP reassembly and detection. One-way flows prevent session reconstruction, break application identification and IDS signatures, causing missed detections and false positives.

recommended_fix.why: Aggregate both directions of each flow at the packet broker so the NDR receives client->server and server->client together for complete session analysis.

findings.root_cause: Traffic bursts exceed NDR port capacity with no load balancing. Peak 21.72 Gbps in 1ms burst vs 10 Gbps port = 217% of capacity (2 overloaded intervals). Even without broker drops, the tool NIC will drop during microbursts.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR will silently drop packets at ingress during bursts, creating blind spots, incomplete flows, and missed alerts despite broker showing healthy. Detection coverage collapses under load.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across multiple 10G NDR ports/nodes via hash-based load balancing to keep per-port utilization <80% and absorb 21+ Gbps bursts without loss.

findings.root_cause: 95.2% of frames (7165/7527) arrive inside ERSPAN tunnel and are delivered encapsulated to the tool. Packet broker is forwarding ERSPAN from remote switches without decapsulation/stripping.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR expects native Ethernet/IP and cannot parse inner payload inside ERSPAN/GRE. It wastes cycles on outer headers, fails to extract L4-L7, and misses 95% of detections; effectively blind to encapsulated traffic.

recommended_fix.why: Configure packet broker to terminate/strip ERSPAN headers and forward only the inner original frames so NDR can inspect full payload with its 9216-byte MTU.
